The '''1924–25 Scottish Division One''' season was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] by three points over nearest rival [[Airdrieonians F.C. (1878)|Airdrieonians]]. [[Ayr United F.C.|Ayr United]] and [[Third Lanark A.C.|Third Lanark]] finished 19th and 20th respectively and were relegated to the [[1925–26 Scottish Division Two]].
